edges.notes: Flux controllers run on Kubernetes and reconcile sources (Git, Helm, OCI) into the cluster via controllers and CRDs.
Flux reconciles Helm repositories and Helm releases via HelmRepository/HelmRelease CRDs per upstream documentation.
Image automation CRDs reconcile workload image references against OCI image tags and digests.
Registry-facing controllers interact with distribution-class HTTP APIs for image manifests and blobs.
Flux Kustomization CRD reconciles kustomize-built manifests from Git sources per upstream documentation.
Substitutable GitOps controller class for Kubernetes continuous delivery; different architecture and UX than Argo CD.
